versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο ἀναχθῆναι ἡμᾶς ἀποσπασθέντας ἀπ’ αὐτῶν, εὐθυδρομήσαντες ἤλθομεν εἰς τὴν Κῶ, τῇ δὲ ἑξῆς εἰς τὴν Ῥόδον κἀκεῖθεν εἰς Πάταρα·

controles.web: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
controles.livre: E quando aconteceu de termos saído deles, e navegado, percorremos diretamente, e viemos a Cós, e n o dia seguinte a Rodes, e dali a Pátara.

versos.grego: καὶ εὑρόντες πλοῖον διαπερῶν εἰς Φοινίκην, ἐπιβάντες ἀνήχθημεν.

controles.web: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.
controles.kjv: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
controles.livre: E tendo achado um navio que passava para a Fenícia, nós embarcamos nele, e partimos.

versos.grego: ἀναφάναντες δὲ τὴν Κύπρον καὶ καταλιπόντες αὐτὴν εὐώνυμον ἐπλέομεν εἰς Συρίαν, καὶ κατήλθομεν εἰς Τύρον· ἐκεῖσε γὰρ τὸ πλοῖον ἦν ἀποφορτιζόμενον τὸν γόμον.

controles.web: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo.
controles.kjv: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
controles.livre: E tendo Chipre à vista, e deixando-a à esquerda, navegamos para a Síria, e viemos a Tiro; porque o navio tinha de deixar ali sua carga.

versos.grego: ἀνευρόντες δὲ τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐπεμείναμεν αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας ἑπτά· οἵτινες τῷ Παύλῳ ἔλεγον διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος μὴ ἐπιβαίνειν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

controles.web: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E nós ficamos ali por sete dias; e achamos aos discípulos, os quais diziam pelo Espírito a Paulo, que não subisse a Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἐγένετο ἐξαρτίσαι ἡμᾶς τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐξελθόντες ἐπορευόμεθα προπεμπόντων ἡμᾶς πάντων σὺν γυναιξὶ καὶ τέκνοις ἕως ἔξω τῆς πόλεως, καὶ θέντες τὰ γόνατα ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν προσευξάμενοι

controles.web: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
controles.kjv: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
controles.livre: E tendo passado ali aqueles dias, nós saímos e seguimos nosso caminho, acompanhando-nos todos com suas mulheres e filhos até fora da cidade; e postos de joelhos na praia, oramos.

versos.grego: ἀπησπασάμεθα ἀλλήλους, καὶ ἐνέβημεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς τὰ ἴδια.

controles.web: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
controles.kjv: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
controles.livre: E saudando-nos uns aos outros, subimos ao navio; e eles voltaram para as casas deles.

versos.grego: Ἡμεῖς δὲ τὸν πλοῦν διανύσαντες ἀπὸ Τύρου κατηντήσαμεν εἰς Πτολεμαΐδα, καὶ ἀσπασάμενοι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἐμείναμεν ἡμέραν μίαν παρ’ αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day.
controles.kjv: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
controles.livre: E nós, acabada a navegação de Tiro, chegamos a Ptolemaida; e tendo saudado aos irmãos, ficamos com eles por um dia.

versos.grego: τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἐξελθόντες ἤλθομεν εἰς Καισαρίαν, καὶ εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φιλίππου τοῦ εὐαγγελιστοῦ ὄντος ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐμείναμεν παρ’ αὐτῷ.

controles.web: On the next day, we, who were Paul’s companions, departed, and came to Caesarea.   We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
controles.kjv: And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Cesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
controles.livre: E n o dia seguinte, Paulo e nós que estávamos com ele, saindo dali, viemos a Cesareia; e entrando na casa de Filipe, o evangelista (que era um dos sete), nós ficamos com ele.

versos.grego: τούτῳ δὲ ἦσαν θυγατέρες τέσσαρες παρθένοι προφητεύουσαι.

controles.web: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
controles.kjv: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
controles.livre: E este tinha quatro filhas, que profetizavam.

versos.grego: Ἐπιμενόντων δὲ ἡμέρας πλείους κατῆλθέν τις ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας προφήτης ὀνόματι Ἄγαβος,

controles.web: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
controles.kjv: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
controles.livre: E ficando nós ali por muitos dias, desceu da Judeia um profeta, de nome Ágabo;

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ἄρας τὴν ζώνην τοῦ Παύλου, δήσας ἑαυτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ τὰς χεῖρας εἶπεν Τάδε λέγει τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον Τὸν ἄνδρα οὗ ἐστιν ἡ ζώνη αὕτη οὕτως δήσουσιν ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ παραδώσουσιν εἰς χεῖρας ἐθνῶν.

controles.web: Coming to us, and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “Thus says the Holy Spirit: ‘So will the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
controles.kjv: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul’s girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
controles.livre: E ele, tendo vindo a nós, e tomando a cinta de Paulo, e atando-se os pés e as mãos, disse: Isto diz o Espírito Santo: Assim os judeus em Jerusalém atarão ao homem a quem pertence esta cinta, e o entregarão nas mãos dos gentios.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἠκούσαμεν ταῦτα, παρεκαλοῦμεν ἡμεῖς τε καὶ οἱ ἐντόπιοι τοῦ μὴ ἀναβαίνειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: When we heard these things, both we and they of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E nós, tendo ouvido isto, rogamos a ele, tanto nós como os que eram daquele lugar, que ele não subisse a Jerusalém.

versos.grego: τότε ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Παῦλος Τί ποιεῖτε κλαίοντες καὶ συνθρύπτοντές μου τὴν καρδίαν; ἐγὼ γὰρ οὐ μόνον δεθῆναι ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀποθανεῖν εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἑτοίμως ἔχω ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
controles.kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo respondeu: O que vós estais fazendo, ao chorarem e afligirem o meu coração? Porque eu estou pronto, não somente para ser atado, mas até mesmo para morrer em Jerusalém, pelo nome do Senhor Jesus.

versos.grego: μὴ πειθομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἡσυχάσαμεν εἰπόντες Τοῦ Κυρίου τὸ θέλημα γινέσθω.

controles.web: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
controles.kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
controles.livre: E como ele não deixou ser persuadido, nós nos aquietamos, dizendo: Faça-se a vontade do Senhor.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας ἐπισκευασάμενοι ἀνεβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα·

controles.web: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E depois daqueles dias, nós nos arrumamos, e subimos a Jerusalém.

versos.grego: συνῆλθον δὲ καὶ τῶν μαθητῶν ἀπὸ Καισαρίας σὺν ἡμῖν, ἄγοντες παρ’ ᾧ ξενισθῶμεν Μνάσωνί τινι Κυπρίῳ, ἀρχαίῳ μαθητῇ.

controles.web: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
controles.kjv: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
controles.livre: E foram também conosco alguns dos discípulos de Cesareia, trazendo consigo a um certo Mnáson, cipriota, discípulo antigo, com o qual íamos nos hospedar.

versos.grego: Γενομένων δὲ ἡμῶν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἀσμένως ἀπεδέξαντο ἡμᾶς οἱ ἀδελφοί.

controles.web: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
controles.kjv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
controles.livre: E quando chegamos a Jerusalém, os irmãos nos receberam com muito boa vontade.

versos.grego: τῇ δὲ ἐπιούσῃ εἰσῄει ὁ Παῦλος σὺν ἡμῖν πρὸς Ἰάκωβον, πάντες τε παρεγένοντο οἱ πρεσβύτεροι.

controles.web: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
controles.kjv: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
controles.livre: E n o dia seguinte, Paulo entrou conosco a casa de Tiago, e todos os anciãos vieram ali.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀσπασάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐξηγεῖτο καθ’ ἓν ἕκαστον ὧν ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν διὰ τῆς διακονίας αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
controles.kjv: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
controles.livre: E tendo os saudado, ele lhes contou em detalhes o que Deus tinha feito entre os gentios por meio do trabalho dele.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεόν, εἶπάν τε αὐτῷ Θεωρεῖς, ἀδελφέ, πόσαι μυριάδες εἰσὶν ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τῶν πεπιστευκότων, καὶ πάντες ζηλωταὶ τοῦ νόμου ὑπάρχουσιν·

controles.web: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
controles.kjv: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
controles.livre: E eles, ao ouvirem, glorificaram ao Senhor, e lhe disseram: Tu vês, irmão, quantos milhares de judeus há que creem, e todos são zelosos da lei.

versos.grego: κατηχήθησαν δὲ περὶ σοῦ ὅτι ἀποστασίαν διδάσκεις ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως τοὺς κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη πάντας Ἰουδαίους, λέγων μὴ περιτέμνειν αὐτοὺς τὰ τέκνα μηδὲ τοῖς ἔθεσιν περιπατεῖν.

controles.web: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children neither to walk after the customs.
controles.kjv: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
controles.livre: E foram informados quanto a ti, que a todos os judeus, que estão entre os gentios, que tu ensinas a se afastarem de Moisés, dizendo que não devem circuncidar seus filhos, nem andar segundo os costumes.

versos.grego: τί οὖν ἐστιν; πάντως ἀκούσονται ὅτι ἐλήλυθας.

controles.web: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
controles.kjv: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
controles.livre: Então o que se fará? Em todo caso ouvirão  que tu já chegaste.

versos.grego: τοῦτο οὖν ποίησον ὅ σοι λέγομεν· εἰσὶν ἡμῖν ἄνδρες τέσσαρες εὐχὴν ἔχοντες ἐφ’ ἑαυτῶν·

controles.web: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
controles.kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
controles.livre: Portanto faça isto que te dizemos: temos quatro homens que fizeram voto.

versos.grego: τούτους παραλαβὼν ἁγνίσθητι σὺν αὐτοῖς, καὶ δαπάνησον ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς ἵνα ξυρήσονται τὴν κεφαλήν, καὶ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ὧν κατήχηνται περὶ σοῦ οὐδέν ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ στοιχεῖς καὶ αὐτὸς φυλάσσων τὸν νόμον.

controles.web: Take them, and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
controles.kjv: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
controles.livre: Toma contigo a estes, e purifica-te com eles, e paga os gastos deles, para que rapem a cabeça, e todos saibam que não há nada do que foram informados sobre ti, mas sim, que tu mesmo andas guardando a Lei.

versos.grego: περὶ δὲ τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἐθνῶν ἡμεῖς ἐπεστείλαμεν κρίναντες φυλάσσεσθαι αὐτοὺς τό τε εἰδωλόθυτον καὶ αἷμα καὶ πνικτὸν καὶ πορνείαν.

controles.web: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
controles.kjv: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
controles.livre: E quanto aos que creem dentre os gentios, nós já escrevemos, julgando que  se abstenham do que se abstenham das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, e do sangue, e da carne sufocada, e do pecado sexual.

versos.grego: τότε ὁ Παῦλος παραλαβὼν τοὺς ἄνδρας τῇ ἐχομένῃ ἡμέρᾳ σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁγνισθεὶς εἰσῄει εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, διαγγέλλων τὴν ἐκπλήρωσιν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ, ἕως οὗ προσηνέχθη ὑπὲρ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου αὐτῶν ἡ προσφορά.

controles.web: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
controles.kjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
controles.livre: Então Paulo, tendo tomado consigo a aqueles homens, e purificando-se com eles no dia seguinte, entrou no Templo, anunciando que já estavam cumpridos dos dias da purificação, quando fosse oferecida por eles, cada um sua oferta.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἔμελλον αἱ ἑπτὰ ἡμέραι συντελεῖσθαι, οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἀσίας Ἰουδαῖοι θεασάμενοι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ συνέχεον πάντα τὸν ὄχλον, καὶ ἐπέβαλαν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας,

controles.web: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
controles.kjv: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
controles.livre: E tendo os sete dias quase quase completados, os judeus da Ásia, vendo-o, tumultuaram a todo o povo, e lançaram as mãos sobre ele para o deterem ,

versos.grego: κράζοντες Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλεῖται, βοηθεῖτε· οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ κατὰ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τοῦ τόπου τούτου πάντας πανταχῇ διδάσκων, ἔτι τε καὶ Ἕλληνας εἰσήγαγεν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ κεκοίνωκεν τὸν ἅγιον τόπον τοῦτον.

controles.web: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple, and has defiled this holy place!”
controles.kjv: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
controles.livre: Clamando: Homens israelitas, ajudai -nos ; este é o homem que por todos os lugares ensina a todos contra o nosso povo, e contra a Lei, e contra este lugar; e além disto, ele também pôs gregos dentro do Templo, e contaminou este santo lugar!

versos.grego: ἦσαν γὰρ προεωρακότες Τρόφιμον τὸν Ἐφέσιον ἐν τῇ πόλει σὺν αὐτῷ, ὃν ἐνόμιζον ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν εἰσήγαγεν ὁ Παῦλος.

controles.web: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
controles.kjv: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
controles.livre: (Porque antes eles tinham visto na cidade a Trófimo junto dele, ao qual pensavam que Paulo tinha trazido para dentro do Templo).

versos.grego: ἐκινήθη τε ἡ πόλις ὅλη καὶ ἐγένετο συνδρομὴ τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενοι τοῦ Παύλου εἷλκον αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ εὐθέως ἐκλείσθησαν αἱ θύραι.

controles.web: All the city was moved, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
controles.kjv: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
controles.livre: E toda a cidade se tumultuou, e houve um ajuntamento do povo; e tendo detido a Paulo, trouxeram-no para fora do Templo; e logo as portas foram fechadas.

versos.grego: Ζητούντων τε αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι ἀνέβη φάσις τῷ χιλιάρχῳ τῆς σπείρης ὅτι ὅλη συνχύννεται Ἱερουσαλήμ·

controles.web: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
controles.kjv: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
controles.livre: E eles, procurando matá-lo, a notícia chegou ao comandante e aos soldados, de que toda Jerusalém estava em confusão.

versos.grego: ὃς ἐξαυτῆς παραλαβὼν στρατιώτας καὶ ἑκατοντάρχας κατέδραμεν ἐπ’ αὐτούς· οἱ δὲ ἰδόντες τὸν χιλίαρχον καὶ τοὺς στρατιώτας ἐπαύσαντο τύπτοντες τὸν Παῦλον.

controles.web: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
controles.kjv: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
controles.livre: O qual, tendo tomado logo consigo soldados e centuriões, correu até eles. E eles, vendo ao comandante e aos soldados, pararam de ferir a Paulo.

versos.grego: τότε ἐγγίσας ὁ χιλίαρχος ἐπελάβετο αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκέλευσεν δεθῆναι ἁλύσεσι δυσί, καὶ ἐπυνθάνετο τίς εἴη καὶ τί ἐστιν πεποιηκώς.

controles.web: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
controles.kjv: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
controles.livre: Então o comandante, tendo se aproximado, prendeu-o, e mandou que ele fosse atado em duas correntes; e perguntou quem ele era, e o que ele tinha feito.

versos.grego: ἄλλοι δὲ ἄλλο τι ἐπεφώνουν ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ· μὴ δυναμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ γνῶναι τὸ ἀσφαλὲς διὰ τὸν θόρυβον, ἐκέλευσεν ἄγεσθαι αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν.

controles.web: Some shouted one thing, and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
controles.kjv: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
controles.livre: E na multidão clamavam uns de uma maneira ,e outros de outra maneira; mas como ele não podia saber com certeza por causa do tumulto, ele mandou que o levassem para a área fortificada.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀναβαθμούς, συνέβη βαστάζεσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν στρατιωτῶν διὰ τὴν βίαν τοῦ ὄχλου·

controles.web: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
controles.kjv: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
controles.livre: E ele, tendo chegado às escadas, aconteceu que ele foi carregado pelos soldados, por causa da violência da multidão.

versos.grego: ἠκολούθει γὰρ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ κράζοντες Αἶρε αὐτόν.

controles.web: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
controles.kjv: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
controles.livre: Porque a multidão do povo o seguia, gritando: Tragam-no para fora!

versos.grego: Μέλλων τε εἰσάγεσθαι εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν ὁ Παῦλος λέγει τῷ χιλιάρχῳ Εἰ ἔξεστίν μοι εἰπεῖν τι πρὸς σέ; ὁ δὲ ἔφη Ἑλληνιστὶ γινώσκεις;

controles.web: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?”   He said, “Do you know Greek?
controles.kjv: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
controles.livre: E Paulo, estando perto de entrar na área fortificada, disse ao comandante: É permitido a mim te falar alguma coisa?E ele disse: Tu sabes grego?

versos.grego: οὐκ ἄρα σὺ εἶ ὁ Αἰγύπτιος ὁ πρὸ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀναστατώσας καὶ ἐξαγαγὼν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοὺς τετρακισχιλίους ἄνδρας τῶν σικαρίων;

controles.web: Aren’t you then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
controles.kjv: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
controles.livre: Por acaso não és tu aquele egípcio, que antes destes dias tinha levantando uma rebelião, e levou ao deserto quatro mil homens assassinos?

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Παῦλος Ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος μέν εἰμι Ἰουδαῖος, Ταρσεὺς, τῆς Κιλικίας οὐκ ἀσήμου πόλεως πολίτης· δέομαι δέ σου, ἐπίτρεψόν μοι λαλῆσαι πρὸς τὸν λαόν.

controles.web: But Paul said, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
controles.kjv: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo lhe disse: Na verdade eu sou um homem judeu de Tarso, cidade não pouca importância da Cilícia; mas eu te rogo para que tu me permitas falar ao povo.

versos.grego: ἐπιτρέψαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ Παῦλος ἑστὼς ἐπὶ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν κατέσεισεν τῇ χειρὶ τῷ λαῷ· πολλῆς δὲ σιγῆς γενομένης προσεφώνησεν τῇ Ἑβραΐδι διαλέκτῳ λέγων

controles.web: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
controles.kjv: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
controles.livre: E tendo lhe permitido, Paulo pôs-se de pé nas escadas, acenou com a mão ao povo; e tendo havido grande silêncio, falou -lhes em língua hebraica, dizendo:
